description: Cancel every Operator listing your wallet signed, at once: returns the ONE unsigned transaction (Seaport incrementCounter) your wallet sends on that chain. Each listing signed the counter it was made under, so a new counter voids them all; operators_market then shows them closed. Moving the token also ends its listing. Nothing is signed or sent here.

wallet.description: the 0x address of the wallet whose listings to cancel

name: operator_cancel
